notes.title: Patch Notes - 07/12/2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41515260/455562ac6bc9c2dbb2dd8455d0bfe18e267f9b6f.png[/img]

Greetings, Zaunites!

It’s been a little while since we released Convergence: A League of Legends Story to the world, and we’ve been super thankful for the fantastic PC-related feedback that has come out of the community since then!

Our main takeaway from your sentiments has been that while PC users have been happy with the game itself, there were a few places where the PC experience could be improved, specifically with regards to keyboard and mouse controls. 

In response to this feedback, we’re happy to share an update that should make playing the game with a keyboard and mouse a much more enjoyable experience. Take a look at the changes below, and let us know what you think in the comments!

[u]Gameplay Improvements[/u]
[olist]
[*] Added mouse aiming for all ranged abilities: Timewinder, Parallel Convergence, and Phase Dive can now all be freely aimed and activated via mouse aiming on PC
[*] Fixed keyboard inputs sometimes being dropped when switching between zip-lining and grinding on rails
[*] Fixed some level checkpoints being invalid and preventing reloads. This also retroactively fixes existing save files that were previously stuck
[/olist]
[u]Menu Improvements[/u]
[olist]
[*] Added full mouse navigation for all menus: All menu footer buttons are now clickable so you can complete the entire game without ever taking your hand off the mouse
[*] Fixed inconsistent and/or slow mouse scrolling in the Codex menus
[*] Fixed many keyboard/mouse-specific issues in the control remapper:
[list]
[*] Fixed inputs sometimes being double-assigned
[*] Fixed being unable to enter control remapping with the mouse
[*] Fixed some keyboard keys not registering for assignment
[*] Fixed being sometimes unable to reset remapped controls to default
[*] Fixed being sometimes unable to exit the control remapper with the mouse
[/list] [*] Fixed multiple gadgets sometimes being selected simultaneously when changing menu tabs[/olist]

notes.title: CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story is Out Now!
notes.content:
The time is now!  CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story, a single player, 2D action platformer with an incredible art style that focuses on tight dynamic combat and unique exploration, is available NOW on Steam!

It is time to traverse the sprawling city of Zaun as Ekko, a young inventor with a device to manipulate time, in this story-driven action platformer. Collect parts, craft gadgets, and unlock abilities—then rewind time to adapt your approach to every new challenge.

Control time. Discover Zaun. Battle Champions! Will it be enough to save Zaun’s future? Seize every moment in CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story.

notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
[b]What type of game is CONVERGENCE?[/b]
The game is a single player, 2D action platformer.

[b]Is the story of CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends story canon?[/b]
Yes, the core narrative will be canon. However CONVERGENCE will feature different expressions of the IP such as cool characters and moments while delivering a unique adventure starring Ekko.

[b]Where does this game take place?[/b]
CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story is an action platformer set in Zaun.

[b]What regions will the game be available in?[/b]
We are aiming to release the game worldwide.

[b]What platforms will the game be on?[/b]
CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story will be available on Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PS4/5, Nintendo Switch, Steam, Epic, and GOG.

[b]Will the game be available for Mac OS?[/b]
Convergence: A League of Legends Story will not be available on Mac OS.

[b]Will there be multiplayer? Can I play with my friends?[/b]
CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story is a single player, action platformer and will not be available to play in multiplayer mode.

[b]Which champions are in the game?[/b]
Players will be able to explore Zaun as Ekko and follow his journey as he discovers that the power to change time comes with consequences. 

[b]Why is this a Riot Forge game?[/b]
Riot Forge is a publishing label within Riot Games that complements Riot’s internally developed games. Our focus is to work with experienced studios outside of Riot Games to create bespoke “completable” games set in the League of Legends universe. CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story is a new story driven RPG set in the  League of Legends universe.

[b]How much will the game cost? Is it Free to Play?[/b]
Riot Forge games will not be free to play. Riot Forge is making premium completable, narrative driven games, opposed to “live services” type games, which include free to play games. 

CONVERGENCE is $29.99

[b]Is CONVERGENCE available to play on next-gen consoles like PS5 and Xbox Series X|S?[/b]
Yes, CONVERGENCE will be available to play on next-gen consoles.

[b]Will there be a mobile version of the CONVERGENCE? [/b]
CONVERGENCE will not be available on mobile. 

[b]Why are you working with Double Stallion?[/b]
We love the unique identity of Double Stallion’s games and their experience in the action platformer genre.  They’ve worked on a number of high profile IPs in the past and have been able to deliver games that are true to the IP with their unique spin.  We’re super excited to be working with them!

[b]What other games have Double Stallion shipped?[/b]
Double Stallion Games creates unique player experiences in familiar genres using gorgeous 2D hand-animated aesthetics that feel fresh and dramatic to modern gamers. They launched Speed Brawl, a 2D combat-racer about moving fast and maintaining momentum through speed runs. Prior to that they worked on OK K.O with Cartoon Network and Big Action Mega Fight. 

[b]How do we know that these partners will treat the IP correctly?[/b]
One of Riot's strengths is the depth we have created within the League of Legends Universe and the Riot Forge team is here to support our developers and ensure they understand all aspects of the world. Our feedback ensures we create authentic League of Legends games together.

notes.title: CONVERGENCE Digital Comic and Art Book Instructions
notes.content:
To launch the CONVERGENCE Digital Comic and Art Book:

1. Locate CONVERGENCE: A League of Legends Story in your Steam Library.
2. Right-click on the game, select ‘Manage’ then select ‘Browse local files.’ This will open your Convergence Steam folder.
3. From there, open the folder named ‘art book.’
4. Double-click the CONVERGENCE Digital Comic and Art book application to launch it
